svg.title: Rounded hooks in a Claude Code session
svg.desc: Session context at start, a force push to main blocked, and a hard-coded GitHub token blocked by the secret scanner.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: Project: demo-shop (JavaScript (npm)) · Git: on main, 2 uncommitted change(s)
Commands: test: npm test, build: npm run build
Handoff note: Next: add the refund endpoint
✗ Rounded guard: Force-pushing to "main" rewrites shared history.
Push to a feature branch and open a pull request instead.
✗ Rounded secret scan: this change contains what looks like a GitHub token (line 1).
Read it from an environment variable or a secret manager instead of hard-coding it.
Nothing was pushed and no secret reached the disk.
